Subject: Intro: Redwood inference walkthrough for Skybridge (scheduling)

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the intro last week — per our call, we'd like a short walkthrough of Redwood's inference platform for the engineering and product leads (2–3 people). Our main concerns are: integration effort with our on-prem telemetry pipeline, predictable latency under burst, and cost estimates for a 6-month pilot.

Are you available for a 45–60 minute demo the week of Dec 6 or Dec 13? Timezone: PST. We have a couple of folks traveling the week of the 6th but afternoon PT slots on the 9th or 10th would work if you have availability.

Attaching a one-page context memo from our product director (internal) to help focus the demo.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Sr. Product Manager | Skybridge AI
alyssa.chen@skybridge.ai

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you. Thanks for the memo, that helps. Monica (our platform engineer) and Rishi (solutions lead) will join; we can cover integration approaches, latency profiles, and a short costing exercise for a 6-month pilot.

Proposed 45-minute slots (PT):
- Thu, Dec 9 — 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Fri, Dec 10 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT

If either works I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. If these are tight because of travel, we can do a recording + live Q&A instead.

Quick ask: if procurement wants to be present for scope/budget questions, loop them into the invite.

Cheers,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Michael — really appreciate the quick options. I wanted to give you an update: after a leadership sync this morning, we’ve decided to shift a number of Q1 initiatives toward mobile telemetry ingestion and deferring new infra pilots that don’t directly unblock the mobile rollout.

Practically that means we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference pilot for now and pause scheduling. Two notes: 1) the work you outlined is still relevant to us long-term, and 2) we may re-open this in Q2 once the mobile rollout stabilizes.

Sorry for the short notice — people are traveling and the budget owner reallocated some headcount to the mobile team. I’ve attached the internal roadmap excerpt that prompted the decision so you have context.

Can you mark this opportunity as paused on your side? I’ll flag you if anything changes or if procurement wants to continue a small feasibility conversation.

Best,
Alyssa

I'll hold off on sending any contract or SOW. Alyssa asked that we mark it paused and she'll reach out if procurement wants a feasibility thread to continue asynchronously.
